source.title: Senior Delegate Announcement - Africa (October 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce we have a new Senior Delegate, Anthony Rush, for Africa.

Anthony was selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2025.1%2520-%2520Senior%2520Delegates.pdf) about Senior Delegates.

<!-- break -->
We extend our support and best wishes to Anthony in fulfilling his new responsibilities. His term as Senior Delegate starts on October 15, 2026.

Anthony was the only applicant we had for the Senior Delegate for Africa role. The candidacy document can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DIUJ_loEpqSaJPQb4ZKdEvRgIkWXP3tm?usp=drive_link).

translation.title: 非洲高级代表任命公告（2026 年 10 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴宣布，Anthony Rush 将担任非洲的新任高级代表。

WCA 董事会依据《高级代表[议案](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2025.1%2520-%2520Senior%2520Delegates.pdf)》第 4 节，经董事会成员投票选出 Anthony。

我们将支持 Anthony 履行新的职责，并向他致以最美好的祝愿。他的高级代表任期自 2026 年 10 月 15 日开始。

Anthony 是此次非洲高级代表职位的唯一申请人。其申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DIUJ_loEpqSaJPQb4ZKdEvRgIkWXP3tm?usp=drive_link)查看。
